Pharmacy POS apps. They open the live pharmacy at https://pharmacy.z88.tech, so data is the same as on the website.

- **Windows**: `Pharmacy-POS-…-win-x64.exe`, run the installer. Windows may say "unknown publisher" (the app is not code-signed yet): choose *More info → Run anyway*. File → Receipt printer… prints receipts straight to the thermal printer.
- **Android**: `Pharmacy-POS-android.apk`, allow "install from this source" when asked. The POS has a camera button for barcodes.
- **Linux**: `.AppImage` or `.deb`.
- **iPhone / any device**: open https://pharmacy.z88.tech in the browser and choose *Add to Home Screen* / *Install app*.

The counter keeps selling when the internet drops (sign in once while online first); sales sync automatically when it is back. Controlled drugs need the connection.
